title: Nametag flicker: which part causes it? (you set the pace)
intro: Reset Scripts first (TestGuide 1.3: steps wait for End). Co-op starts by itself. Don't move; watch the pawn nametags and note yes/no for steps 1-4.

steps.text: Hands off - starting co-op. Stand near the pawns.
1) Normal co-op - flicker? Remember yes/no, then press End
2) DPC camera block OFF - flicker? Then press End
3) DPC controller zeroing also OFF - flicker? Then press End
Both back ON. Open REFramework menu > Camera Distance, untick 'Keep player 2's pawn on screen', close the menu, press End
4) Camera co-op framing OFF - flicker? Then press End
Tick 'Keep player 2's pawn on screen' again, press End

probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active
